jobs.title: Supply Chain Controller Accounting Manager
jobs.description: Overview Overview Lead end-to-end supply chain controller for Quaker and Agro operations, driving strategic cost management, inventory governance, productivity initiatives, financial stewardship, and business decision support to optimize profitability, working capital, and operational efficiency. Responsibilities Responsibilities Own the financial control framework across Quaker and Agro supply chain operations, ensuring strong governance over inventory, manufacturing costs, logistics costs, and operational spending. Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement and Commercial leaders to drive strategic business decisions and deliver sustainable productivity improvements. Lead monthly supply chain performance reviews, highlighting risks, opportunities, and actionable insights to senior leadership in factory. Develop/support cost optimization roadmaps aligned with business growth objectives. Act as key finance business partner and subject matter expert for supply chain costing, inventory valuation, and operational controls. Cost Control & Productivity Management Lead actual fixed cost and variable cost governance across manufacturing, warehousing, agriculture, and logistics operations. Monitor absorption, standard cost accuracy, manufacturing variances, yield losses, and operational efficiency metrics. Provide strategic recommendations to improve cost competitiveness and margin performance. Inventory Control & Working Capital Management Own inventory governance, support physical count programs, cycle counts, reconciliations, and inventory accuracy across warehouses operations. Monitor inventory aging, slow-moving stock, obsolete inventory, inventory provisions, and working capital performance. Ensure compliance with inventory policies, US GAAP/Local GAAP requirements, and company control standards. Perform and support root cause analysis of inventory variances and implement preventive controls with other stake holder and respective user. Financial Reporting & Analysis Ensure accurate and timely month-end closing related to inventory, costing, and supply chain operations. Present key insights and recommendations to supply chain and finance leadership teams. Controls, Compliance & Risk Management Strengthen internal controls across inventory, procurement, manufacturing, and agricultural processes. Support internal and external audits while ensuring strong compliance culture. Identify operational and financial risks proactively and develop mitigation plans. Drive continuous improvement of financial processes, digitalization, and reporting automation. Leadership & Team Development Lead, coach, and develop supply chain controlling team members. Build strong cross-functional partnerships across multiple business units and stakeholders. Promote a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Qualifications Requirements 8-10+ years of finance/accounting experience with strong exposure to supply chain finance, product costing, and inventory controlling. Experience in FMCG and multinational environments. Strong knowledge of standard costing, manufacturing accounting, inventory valuation, and cost analytics. Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive strategic decisions. Strong SAP FI/CO and reporting systems knowledge. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor degree in Accounting or Finance; professional qualification is an advantage.

jobs.title: Category Manager, PFNA, Target
jobs.description: Overview Your primary responsibility is to serve as a snacking category expert at Target and Frito-Lay. As Category Captain for Chips and Multipack, you will lead with objective, data-driven insights that elevates the total snacking aisle — from POG development, assortment architecture, and shelf space allocation to insight development, reporting, and business performance storytelling. You will: Lead end-to-end Category Captaincy for Chips and Multipack at Target, acting as an objective advisor to Target Buyers and delivering POG, assortment, and space strategies grounded in consumer and shopper truth. Own planogram development and management — from data-driven shelf architecture and space allocation recommendations through the full Target POG building and submission process. Serve as a foremost resource on the snacking landscape — synthesizing macro consumer trends, health and wellness shifts, permissible indulgence patterns, emerging segment growth, and competitive dynamics into a forward-looking point of view. Advise across the broader snacks category, identifying white space opportunities, cross-segment dynamics, and assortment gaps that give Target a sustainable competitive advantage in the snacking aisle. Support Store-level POG execution through partnering across Frito’s regional DSD network to identify solutions and foster executional partnerships Your secondary responsibilities include leveraging multiple data sources to gain a deep understanding of consumer and shopper behavior across products, geographies, cohorts, and occasions — driving Target's snacking learning agenda and informing category planning. Responsibilities As a Category Manager within the North American Insights & Intelligence organization, you will serve as the leading voice on snacking at Target and a Category Captaincy lead for the POG-building process. You will be required to: Lead planogram development and manage Target's POG submission process for Chips and Multipack — leveraging AI and automation tools to drive POG-build efficiency and deliver next-level shelf recommendations grounded in shopper and category data. Track and synthesize key trends shaping the snacking landscape — including consumer macro shifts, permissible snacking, on-the-go formats, value tier dynamics, and emerging segment growth — translating these into strategic category guidance and line review recommendations. Develop category reviews and assortment recommendations that reflect a total-category perspective across snack segments, incorporating syndicated data (Circana, NielsenIQ, Panel), shopper insights, and competitive intelligence into a clear, compelling narrative. Develop insight-based reporting, seasonal program assessments, and assortment impact studies that translate performance trends into actionable recommendations Stay ahead of industry developments, retail innovation, AI-enabled category management capabilities, and best practices — continuously building expertise that strengthens Target's position in snacking. Partner cross-functionally with key stakeholders. Compensation and Benefits: The expected compensation range for this position is between $110,700 - $185,250. PepsiCo offers a Fixed and Variable Rate (FAVR) reimbursement benefit for this role. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree required; MBA a plus. 5+ years of Category Management or Insights experience within the consumer packaged goods industry. Demonstrated experience leading Category Captaincy, category advisor, or POG-building responsibilities at Target is strongly preferred; comparable experience with other large-format retailers will be considered. Hands-on experience with JDA Space Planning Software; familiarity with automated space planning tools such as ShelfIQ is a strong plus. 3–5 years of experience analyzing and interpreting syndicated data, including Circana, NielsenIQ, panel data, and customer POS platforms such as RSI and VendorIQ. Experience with, or strong desire to quickly adopt, AI-enabled tools such as Microsoft Copilot and ChatGPT to accelerate insight development, improve organization, and enhance efficiency in analysis and communication. jobs.title: Sales Manager Wholesale BLUX & Traditional Trade Lead BNLX
jobs.description: Overview The Sales Manager Wholesale BLUX & Traditional Trade Lead BNLX is accountable for building and leading a scalable BNLX Traditional Trade and BLUX Wholesale growth platform. The role has a dual mandate: accelerating the established Netherlands Traditional Trade roadmap while defining and implementing the Belgium Traditional Trade and Wholesale strategy, Go-To-Market model and execution roadmap required to unlock a structurally underdeveloped channel. In the Netherlands, the focus is on accelerating outlet development, expanding distribution, strengthening execution and scaling the Traditional Trade model. In Belgium and Luxembourg, the role will translate proven Netherlands learnings into market-specific strategies, develop strategic wholesale partnerships, and build the capabilities and execution model required to drive sustainable growth. This role is critical to unlocking significant whitespace opportunities across BNLX through Traditional Trade, regional and ethnic wholesalers, preferred national partners and strategic channel partnerships, delivering accelerated growth across volume, net revenue, profitability and market share. Responsibilities Business Own delivery of BNLX Traditional Trade and BLUX Wholesale AOP targets across volume, net revenue, profitability and market share. Accountable for the BLUX Wholesale agenda across priority national, regional and ethnic wholesale customers. Responsible for building strategic Wholesale and Traditional Trade partnerships, including the execution of the Van Dijk partnership and scaling successful learnings across BNLX. Define the BNLX Traditional Trade Go-To-Market approach and BLUX Wholesale strategy across regional wholesalers, preferred national partners and strategic data-sharing partnerships. Drive outlet conversion, distribution expansion and revenue growth through effective channel execution and customer development. Leverage market insights, customer data and performance analytics to identify growth opportunities and strengthen channel competitiveness. Organization & Leadership Lead, coach and develop the Traditional Trade and Wholesale teams, ensuring strong execution discipline, capability building and delivery against channel targets. Design and operationalize the BNLX Traditional Trade and Wholesale execution model required to drive scalable growth across the Netherlands, Belgium and Luxembourg. Build strong cross-functional partnerships with Sales, Shopper Marketing, Marketing, Finance and Supply Chain to accelerate channel development. Represent Traditional Trade and Wholesale in relevant leadership and cross-functional forums, ensuring channel priorities are embedded in business planning. Collaborate with Sector and European teams to share best practices and drive continuous improvement across the channel. Qualifications Strong combination of strategic thinking and hands-on execution leadership. Results-oriented growth leader with clear communication, high ownership and strong commercial drive. Strong communication, influencing and relationship management skills across senior stakeholders, cross-functional teams and external partners. Strong business acumen and P&L mindset, with ability to balance growth, profitability and investment choices. Transformational mindset: able to challenge the status quo, simplify complexity and define how PepsiCo wins in underdeveloped channels. Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with ability to translate strategy into clear priorities, execution plans and measurable outcomes. Graduate / University degree or equal through experience Minimum 6 years of FMCG experience, ideally with exposure to sales leadership, customer development, route-to-market or channel strategy. Fluent Dutch + English required Preferred locations: Utrecht NL, Zaventem BEL

jobs.title: Revenue Growth Manager - Beverage
jobs.description: Overview At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you. We are looking for a Revenue Growth Manager, Beverage based in İstanbul and who will be responsible for leading the strategic approach that helps PepsiCo to maximize revenue and deliver sustainable growth by optimizing Pack Price, Promotional Spend, Product / Account Mix, Trade Terms. This is a critical role to drive long-term sustainable top line growth for the “Turkey Beverage Category”. The role defines holistic 3-5 years Pack Price Architecture strategies, by leveraging data analytics and insights. The role will be the key point of influence in enabling growth via Occasion and consumer-based pack and price architecture through the year. As part of this the role will also collaborate with RGM capability workstreams and be an important contributor of beverage commercial teams. Responsibilities Design the Beverage Net Revenue Annual Operating Plan (AOP) in Pack Price Architecture, working closely with Beverage Category teams, BU Commercial Teams and Sales / Sales Finance Teams Influence Category Strategic Plan (ICP) Revenue Algorithm defining the 3-5 year Pack Price Architecture strategy, including but not limited to price tiering and geography/ channel/segment base price differentiation, that is fully integrated with commercial levers Make sure that Pack Price Architecture address internal, consumer, customer and competitor objectives and identify Pack Price changes to realise consumer opportunities & drive revenue realisation Support definition of ongoing revenue realisation activities, to increase Net Rev / Kg and drive profitable Revenue growth – typically the key plan-makers in the AOP - whilst protecting share Work with Marketing teams for the right Pack Price for new product launches Drive Pack Price Architecture agenda for “Bimonthly Revenue Council”; ie; step back review of in market and commercial performance (audience: GM, Executive Commercial members, CFO, Sales Leadership, Marketing) Lead deep-dives to fully understand and address performance issues (by product/ account) Work closely with RGM Capability Team and ICC to Execute RGM capability agenda and Northstar projects like Price Elasticity, BL/OBPA within RGM's core work and within the finance and commercial functions Define course-correcting actions from bespoke projects / performance deep-dives Qualifications Applicant must be immediately credible in Revenue Management: 7+ years CPG experience with at least 3 years Revenue Management experience, preferably including both Strategy & Execution and covering each discipline (Pack/Price/Promotions/Trade Terms/Mix) Deep experience in revenue management and/or consumer research techniques: Deep analytical expertise, financial / P&L competency, consumer research experience, Conjoint experience, elasticity measurement techniques Insights & agency experience across both Shopper & Consumer Experience with big data techniques desired, but not essential Ability to articulate complex concepts in clear, simple & logical terms & build compelling presentations & professional communications (in English & Turkish) Strategic thinking skills – ability to review complex data, pulling out key insights & translating into high level storylines & concise practical plans for execution Commercial Acumen – Strong commercial and analytical ability required to manage both the operational and strategic agenda and strong analytical and Excel skills Self starter – able to drive progress in an ambiguous environment Strong results orientation, track record of hitting and exceeding targets Change management – leading large scale change throughout levels of an organization Can articulate complex issues in an easy to understand way

jobs.description: Overview The Marketing Lead, HK-SG role will be responsible for helping define and lead, the brand marketing plans and how it incorporates into the bigger country business strategy. The Marketing Lead is primarily responsible for driving profitable Brands growth, aligning concept development, campaigns and NPDs, all anchored in deep and meaningful consumer insight. As a Marketing Leader, you will have direct impact in driving brand volume, revenue, share and equity building to scale-up the portfolio in two of APAC’s most dynamic markets: Hong Kong and Singapore. This also includes managing internal cross-functional teams, external creative agencies, partnership with insights & commercialization. Additionally, this role will also be responsible to manage strong portfolio in the market; driving core brands execution, while building opportunities for new segment/imported/premium portfolio presence. You will be expected to have a close pulse on consumer trends, communications landscape, competitive activity, category developments and sales information. Responsibilities What you will be responsible for: Build and deploy a sharp, differentiated and consumer resonant brand architecture (core brands & extensions) with strongly embedding local insights. Drive brand Net Revenue and Market Share growth via gold-standard delivery of equity and comms plans Lead the management of the brand; developing objectives, strategy, budgets & resources. Lead the development & evolution of the brand positioning & communication within global guardrails. Lead the execution and development of brand plans including: Consumer advertising and promotion ideation, screening, testing and execution Build and deliver Annual Operating Plan (AOP) Innovation pipeline Collaborate with category leader on the communications/branding to ensure: Represents accretive programming to individual Brand plans Maintains equity guardrails. Leverages Brands’ existing assets, where appropriate Support in development on Brands (thematic / platform / consumer engagement / campaigns) including localization of Global content on global brands Build strong partnership with commercial team: Ensure the right channel mix and campaign plans to optimize target consumer reach Create a Roadmap and execute the brand to drive Penetration & Affordability, including pac & price strategy Collaborate to create strongly relevant brand activities in trade and consumer Ensure On-time In-full launch of new innovations through BPOM Registration, Halal Certification, Packaging Design etc. Define, lead and execute brand partnerships & sponsorships with third parties / partners Liaise with BU market activation team to bring alive the programs – effective deployment of the marketing plans Partner with marketing services team on media properties to amplify brand message and break clutter. Partner with insights to build strong consumer, competitors and channel insights; to track brand share performance, brand equity/brand health, product/concept testing and immersion with consumer/market. Deliver strong consumer and trade relevant concepts for input into the planning process, aligning stakeholders and working with agency partners across creative, media, R&D and Packaging Teams. Partner with commercialization and R&D to develop the winning innovation concepts and flavours. Qualifications What you will need to have: 8 to 10 years’ experience and proven track record of Brand management or Brand Marketing MBA, BBA, Marketing Major, or any related field of study Language: Fluency in Mandarin, Cantonese is required Strong understanding of marketing and brand building Proven experience in FMCG business is required (Foods FMCG experience is an advantage) Strong collaboration and Project management skills Entrepreneurial mindset with proven experiences to execute & scale up business opportunities Adaptability, Quick and Eager learner Great presentation skills Strategic thinking and analytical skills Differentiating Competencies Required Strong leadership of projects Ability to manage several portfolios Having the ability to look at the broader picture Management to leading the brand at a strategic level and defining the direction for the future Elevate relationships with market teams – from being a great collaborator who provides task-based help to a strategic partner who is helping to set the strategic direction for them

jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager (Carbonated Soft Drinks)
jobs.description: Overview At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Pepsi, Doritos and Lipton Ice Tea, our work touches millions of people every day. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you. We are looking for a Brand Manager (Carbonated Soft Drinks) based in İstanbul and who will be responsible for leading the development and execution of CSD brand strategy in Türkiye by driving sustainable business growth, building strong brand equity, delivering impactful consumer-centric campaigns, and leading the innovation agenda in collaboration with cross-functional and global teams. Responsibilities Drive sustainable business growth and deliver brand performance against key business objectives, including revenue, volume, market share, and brand equity KPIs. Co-lead local brand strategies in line with global brand vision, ensuring consistency across all consumer touchpoints. Co-lead impactful communication platforms, campaigns, and brand initiatives. Define the annual brand agenda and marketing calendar, ensuring alignment across key internal and external stakeholders. Lead the innovation agenda by identifying, growth opportunities, leveraging globally existing innovations for TR business Drive end-to-end communication and activation strategies, ensuring best-in-class execution across ATL, BTL, digital, social, and experiential channels. jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description: Overview The SAP MDM Material Master role is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of material master data in SAP, in alignment with global master data governance policies. This position bridges SAP technical processes with business requirements, ensuring that material data is clean, standardized, and available across all ERP modules Responsibilities 1. Finished Good (SKU) Code Set up in SAP Support the planning and set-up of the pipeline of New Products (Innovation, Artwork changes and Revenue management projects) by liaising with the Marketing team, R&D Packaging, R&D Product, Supply team, Demand Planning, Master Data and Procurement Own the creation of new finished goods codes. Follow up with stakeholders to ensure information is supplied in a timely manner 2. Product Hierarchy/ PPG/ MG4 Sector Request Spreadsheet to fill out of how the SKU is categorized (7 different sub-categories for one NPD) in addition to PPG and MPG inputs 3. Barcodes Generating new barcodes both EAN and TUN for all NPD’s. Getting the barcodes validated through GS1 (Retailer request) by providing individual barcodes for every SKU 4. Material Master Data Governance Establish and uphold global data governance policies for material master data. Define and document data creation, update, and decision-rights processes. Ensure compliance with SAP master data standards. Execute and oversee material master data maintenance in SAP, including product data cleansing and validation Resolve data quality issues, performance bottlenecks, and inconsistencies. Manage material master records across all relevant SAP views (Basic Data, Accounting, Inventory, Purchasing, Sales, Quality, etc.) Review, maintain, and update Desktop Procedures (DTPs) to ensure documentation accuracy and process standardization. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, IT, Supply Chain, or related field.

Gather, analyze and streamline business processes to deliver efficiency to the FLNA Supply Chain. Develop and execute analytical tools, using Excel and Access, which business teams will then use to achieve performance objectives. Support user acceptance testing for new FLNA project and system enhancements. Develop and deliver training materials required to implement new tools, enhancements or procedures. Accountable for 1k+ idocs per day for resolution if failure within a given SLA Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Management, or applicable degree preferred Fluent in English Strong analytical skills Working knowledge of SAP ECC & SAP Hana Practical working/programing knowledge of Excel, Access, VBA & SQL a plus Excellent presentation skills, both written and verbal 1-2 years experience in Supply Chain Ability to communicate and articulate opportunities and solutions Ability to collaborate and influence in a cross functional team environment Working knowledge of order processing, order life-cycle and/or master data desired Ability to recognize and take action to resolve issues quickly and efficiently whilst escalating root cause deep dive to appropriate teams

jobs.title: Deputy Manager - Supply Chain
jobs.description: Overview This position is responsible for working closely with Business, Functional, and IT teams on various IDOC message types related to Supply Chain operations. The role involves monitoring, resolving, and managing IDOC issues related to Master Data, Order to Cash (OTC) flow, and Sales & Distribution processes to ensure smooth system operations and minimal business disruption. In addition to core operational responsibilities, this role includes handling critical IDOC failures, managing weekly PID monitoring activities, addressing ad-hoc business requests, and supporting business stakeholders as a secondary point of contact. The role also focuses on maintaining process documentation, supporting process improvements, and ensuring compliance with established operational procedures. The individual is accountable for ensuring timely IDOC resolution within SLA timelines, supporting business continuity, and driving operational efficiency through process governance, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement initiatives. Responsibilities Monitor and resolve IDOC failures related to Supply Chain, OTC, and Sales & Distribution processesto ensure smooth business operations. Responsible for processing and managing critical IDOCs & responding to ECG alerts on priorityensuring minimal disruption to business transactions and logistics operations. Perform weekly monitoring and posting of PID activities, ensuring accuracy and timely completion. Act as a Secondary Point of Contact (SPOC) for business stakeholders, supporting queries, issue resolution, and operational guidance. Address ad hoc priority requests from business teamsand ensure quick turnaround time to support urgent operational needs. Work closely with field business users and IT support teams to understand operational requirements and support system improvements. Coordinate with functional and technical teams to identify root causes of recurring IDOC failures and implement preventive solutions. Support SAP HANA related processes and system functionalities, ensuring proper data flow across systems. Review, maintain, and update Desktop Procedures (DTPs)to ensure documentation accuracy and process standardization. Assist in testing new SAP enhancements and supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) Support cross-functional teams during high volume operational periods such as month-end or quarter-end activities. Collaborate with IT and functional teams to ensure timely resolution of incidents and system issues impacting supply chain processes. To identify process improvements and contribute alongside leads in implementing the same Provide knowledge sharing and guidance to team members on IDOC monitoring, error handling, and process best practices. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Management, or related field Strong experience in SAP ECC / SAP S4 HANA environments, particularly in Supply Chain processes Hands-on experience in IDOC monitoring, troubleshooting, and incident resolution Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Experience working with Excel, VBA automation

jobs.title: Away from Home Sales Leader - 12 month contract
jobs.description: Overview An exciting opportunity to join PepsiCo's Away From Home (AFH) team and play a leading role in driving growth across the UK Contract Catering channel. This position will have direct responsibility for managing key strategic partnerships including Elior, Entegra (Sodexo) and Aramark, whilst also playing a pivotal role in shaping and delivering PepsiCo's execution strategy across the wider contract catering landscape. Reporting into the Contract Catering lead, you will be accountable for developing customer strategies, delivering commercial objectives, and unlocking new growth opportunities across workplace, education, healthcare, defence, and leisure catering environments. Away From Home is a strategically important and fast-growing part of the PepsiCo business, offering broad exposure across multiple channels, customer groups and commercial functions. This role provides an excellent platform for developing strategic customer leadership, route-to-market expertise, and commercial account management capabilities. Responsibilities Customer Strategy & Growth Develop and deliver customer business plans for Elior, Entegra (Sodexo) and Aramark, aligned to PepsiCo's AFH growth ambitions and annual operating plan. Identify opportunities to drive volume, revenue and market share growth across snacks and food categories within contract catering environments. Develop customer-specific growth strategies that leverage consumer insights, category trends and operator needs. Drive distribution gains, menu penetration and portfolio expansion across contract catering sites and managed contracts. Support the wider development of PepsiCo's Contract Catering strategy, identifying scalable opportunities to grow share across the sector. Strategic Customer Management Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across Elior, Entegra and Aramark. Lead commercial negotiations, annual planning processes, joint business plans and contract discussions. Develop PepsiCo's position as a strategic growth partner through insight-led selling and value creation. Collaborate with customer procurement, commercial, culinary and operations teams to unlock new opportunities. Monitor performance against agreed objectives and take proactive action to address risks and accelerate growth. Field Sales Leadership & Execution Work closely with Powerforce leadership and PepsiCo sales teams to identify target outlets, priority brands and execution standards. Drive best-in-class execution across availability, visibility, menu placement, equipment opportunities and promotional activity. Ensure strong communication and alignment between customer plans and field execution priorities. Commercial Delivery Deliver annual volume, revenue and profitability targets across your account portfolio. Manage promotional investment and customer-specific funding with a strong focus on return on investment. Identify opportunities to improve contract compliance, distribution performance and execution standards. Utilise data, insight and reporting tools to track performance and inform customer growth plans. Innovation & Portfolio Expansion Lead the deployment of PepsiCo innovation within Contract Catering, including snacks, food and emerging portfolio opportunities. Champion the Food Ventures agenda and identify relevant opportunities for concepts such as Doritos Loaded and future food platforms. Partner with Marketing and Category teams to develop compelling activation plans and customer propositions. Identify new routes to market and opportunities to strengthen PepsiCo's presence across workplace and institutional catering. Qualifications Essential Strong commercial mindset with a proven track record of delivering results against targets and business objectives. Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both internally and externally. Experience managing customer relationships, negotiations and joint business planning processes. Strong analytical capability with the ability to translate data and insights into actionable growth plans. Experience managing multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced commercial environment. Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and drive alignment across teams. Highly proactive, resilient and comfortable operating in an evolving environment. Preferred Experience within FMCG, Foodservice, Away From Home or Contract Catering channels. Understanding of contract catering operators, buying groups and route-to-market dynamics. Experience working with strategic national accounts and multi-site operators. Exposure to field sales management or third-party agency relationships. Experience developing and delivering customer growth strategies through insight and innovation. Leadership Behaviours Growth mindset with a passion for identifying and unlocking new opportunities. Strong ownership and accountability for delivering results. Customer-obsessed and externally focused. Collaborative and highly effective at building partnerships. Curious, insight-driven and action-oriented. Resilient and adaptable in a dynamic commercial environment. Ambitious with a passion for winning in the marketplace. Success Measures Delivery of annual volume, net revenue and profitability targets. Growth of PepsiCo share and distribution within Elior, Entegra and Aramark. Increased penetration of PepsiCo's snacks and food portfolio within contract catering environments. Delivery of best-in-class customer relationships and joint business plans. Identification and implementation of new growth opportunities across the Contract Catering sector. Salary and benefits: Competetive salary Company tablet and mobile Company car Flexible benefits package. 25 days holiday (with the option to buy or sell more) + bank holidays. Extensive pension scheme. Opportunities: The opportunities and channels for growth and progression are endless here at PepsiCo and being a company which strives on enhancing our employees we are positive that you will be able to have incredible and extensive career at PepsiCo. Lead the periodic and month end reporting of operating costs. Controls Define roles and responsibilities for Singapore Legal Entity controls and financials. Compliance Responsible for Sox testing coordination and reporting for CMSPL Act as point person for communication & Resolution of accounting, reporting and control issues between CMSPL and HQ Liaise with external auditors in support of their requirements Compliance with all Manufacturing GMP and Plant Food Safety Policies Ensure compliance with all applicable PepsiCo, Federal, State, and Local regulations and standards Qualifications What you will need to have: Bachelor Business Administration, Major Accounting / Accountancy Qualification 8 years+ proven working experience in Accounting and Finance leadership roles Proven Strategic thinking capability Proven ability to manage business complexity and change, and manage multiple priorities Extensive Control Experience Strong financial and analytical skills Sox Experience a must Computer literate, Microsoft Business applications, SAP Experience a must Excellent supervisory and communication skills and strong interpersonal skills coupled with a collaborative approach, to get things done both up and across the organization Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization, ability to influence and align teams in a matrix and virtual environment Resilient, with flexible upbeat and positive attitude to act as strong role model Entrepreneurial mindset to drive cost effective growth

jobs.title: Manager - Global Procurement
jobs.description: Overview Manage strategic sourcing activities for pre-aligned projects across Tech & Services category or projects & strategy development and execution for pre-aligned specific sub categories, ensuring alignment with business needs, delivering YoY cost savings, Additional Value and driving compliance. Partnering with internal stakeholders across category & market within EMEA Procurement, legal and suppliers to enable efficient, value-driven, and compliant sourcing across the EMEA region. Responsibilities Lead 7-Step Sourcing Process under the supervision and final alignment of EMEA Procurement team and deliver YoY cost savings, Additional Value, contract coverage, and sourcing productivity as per annual targets. Own strategic sourcing process: from stakeholder intake, market scan, Sourcing strategy, RFx setup, analyses and execution to contract negotiation. Also handle contract management scope. Drive innovation & continuous improvement initiatives across the projects and Sub categories assigned Conduct supplier selection, negotiations, and award decisions with clear alignment to business, cost, compliance, and sustainability goals. Draft, negotiate, and execute contracts in partnership with legal, category leads, and suppliers, ensuring terms meet PepsiCo’s compliance and business requirements. Drive supplier onboarding and qualification including financial due diligence, scorecard setup, and reference checks. Manage eSourcing & Contract management tools and lead automation, digitization, and dashboarding initiatives across procurement touchpoints. Ensure compliance with procurement policies and maintain high-quality documentation and reporting of contracts, supplier data, and project pipelines. jobs.title: North America Enterprise Architecture Director - Supply Chain
jobs.description: Overview The North America Supply Chain Domain Architect is responsible for defining and governing the supply chain solution architecture strategy, standards compliance, and technology roadmaps across Supply Chain Planning, Manufacturing, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Warehousing, Transportation, and Fleet capabilities. The role partners with North America Supply Chain Transformation, Business teams, Product, Engineering, Data & AI, and Global domain Architecture teams to translate business priorities into scalable, future-ready technology solutions while ensuring alignment to enterprise architecture standards and principles. The role serves as the primary supply chain architecture leader in North America for the Supply Chain domain and supports execution of the broader Supply Chain & Operations architecture strategy. Responsibilities Define and maintain Supply Chain architectures for sector initiatives in alignment with the global technology standards, capability models, and business flows. Establish target-state architecture and technology roadmaps across Manufacturing, Enterprise Asset Management (EAM), Warehousing, Transportation, and Fleet capabilities. Lead technology assessments and recommendations to support business and transformation priorities in collaboration with the global domain architects. Drive adoption of common platforms, patterns, and standards to simplify and modernize the technology landscape. Define conceptual, logical, and physical architectures for strategic Make & Move initiatives across North America. Define solution architecture approaches that enable scalability, maintainability, security, and long-term sustainability. Develop reusable architecture patterns and implementation guidance to accelerate solution delivery. Support architecture reviews and provide guidance to ensure alignment with enterprise standards. Drive architecture alignment across all supply chain initiatives and solutions in North America. Identify architecture risks, dependencies, and exceptions and drive resolution through established governance processes. Partner with global supply chain domain Architecture, Product, Engineering, Data & AI, and Cybersecurity teams to ensure consistency and reuse. Promote alignment to enterprise capability models, technology strategies, and architecture standards. Partner with global and regional stakeholders to ensure solutions can scale across sectors and markets. Leverage architecture patterns supporting cloud-enabled, data-driven, and AI-enabled business capabilities. Promote interoperability, reusable integration approaches, and common information models across Planning, Manufacturing, EAM, Warehousing, Transportation, and Fleet solutions. Proven experience supporting large-scale business transformation initiatives and technology modernization programs. Strong understanding of architecture frameworks, integration technologies, cloud platforms, enterprise data concepts, and AI-enabled business capabilities. Experience operating within global, federated organizations and partnering across Product, Engineering, Data & AI, Cybersecurity, and Enterprise Architecture teams. Supply Chain Architecture Leadership: Provides architecture direction across Manufacturing, EAM, Warehousing, Transportation, and Fleet capabilities. Systems Thinking: Understands end-to-end relationships across Make & Move processes and platforms. Architectural Excellence: Translates business priorities into scalable architecture and solution patterns. jobs.title: Cybersecurity GRC Assoc Principal
jobs.description: Overview The GRC Associate Principal supports the execution and operational management of PepsiCo's Global Information Security Requirements (GISR) program and governance of PepsiCo's third-party cybersecurity obligations. This role partners with Cybersecurity, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity requirements are incorporated into third-party agreements, monitor compliance with contractual cybersecurity obligations, and provide metrics and reporting that support risk management, regulatory compliance, and program effectiveness. The position also helps drive alignment between cybersecurity policies, contractual requirements, and third-party governance processes. Responsibilities Manage the execution of PepsiCo's GISR contract governance program, including contract reviews, cybersecurity requirement assessments, and negotiation support. Maintain governance processes, controls, reporting, and compliance activities to ensure consistent adoption of cybersecurity contractual requirements Partner with Cybersecurity, Legal, Procurement, and business stakeholders to support policy alignment, regulatory initiatives, training, and continuous program improvement. jobs.title: Manager Excellence Opérationnelle & Performance Supply Chain, CDD, H/F
jobs.description: Overview Manager Excellence Opérationnelle & Performance Supply Chain, CDD, H/F WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKE US BETTER Vous êtes à la recherche de nouveaux défis ? Vous êtes prêt à propulser votre carrière ? Postulez dès maintenant ! Venez exprimer vos talents et votre perspective unique chez nous. Nous vous donnerons les moyens d’oser à l’échelle mondiale et de faire partie d’un groupe qui fait la différence. Vous aurez l’opportunité de booster votre carrière et de définir votre avenir dans un environnement collaboratif et innovant. Les équipes Supply Chain PepsiCo France recherchent leur futur(e) Manager Excellence Opérationnelle & Performance Supply Chain en CDD, à partir de novembre à mars 2027. C'est une mission de 5 mois à fort impact, au cœur de la transformation et de la performance Supply Chain de PepsiCo France. Responsibilities Votre quotidien avec nous : En tant que Manager Excellence Opérationnelle & Performance Supply Chain, vous serez responsable de la définition, de l'animation et du pilotage des initiatives de productivité pour les activités Make (Food & Beverage) et Move de PepsiCo France. Vous contribuerez directement à l'amélioration de la performance opérationnelle de nos usines partenaires et au déploiement des programmes stratégiques de transformation de la Supply Chain. Piloter la stratégie de productivité: Définir et animer la feuille de route Productivité de PepsiCo France. Identifier et prioriser les opportunités d'amélioration de la performance. Assurer le pilotage et la réalisation des projets de transformation et d'optimisation. Influencer et mobiliser les parties prenantes afin de garantir l'atteinte des objectifs. Représenter la France auprès des équipes Productivité du secteur et du cluster. Assurer le suivi et le reporting des indicateurs clés de performance. Developper l'excellence opérationnelle de la SC et des usines partenaires: Accompagner les équipes dans l'identification et la mise en œuvre d'opportunités d'amélioration continue. Animer la communauté Lean Six Sigma et contribuer à son développement. Utiliser les méthodologies d'amélioration continue (DMAIC, RCA, Lean, etc.) pour résoudre des problématiques complexes. Améliorer la performance des lignes de production et l'utilisation des ressources de nos partenaires industriels. Favoriser le partage des meilleures pratiques au sein de l'organisation. Qualifications Vos atouts pour être notre futur talent : Diplôme Bac+5 (École d'Ingénieur, École de Commerce ou Université). 5+ ans d'expérience dans les domaines Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement ou Business Transformation. Expérience réussie dans la gestion de projets transverses et l'amélioration continue. Connaissance des méthodologies Lean Six Sigma (certification appréciée). Solides capacités d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes. Excellentes compétences en communication, influence et gestion des parties prenantes. Capacité à évoluer dans un environnement exigeant et en constante évolution. Anglais courant. Le groupe PepsiCo Où que vous soyez, nous y sommes déjà. Retrouvez PepsiCo et nos produits sur tous les continents, présents dans le quotidien de milliards d’habitants de plus de 200 pays. Notre portefeuille compte notamment 22 marques générant chacune un chiffre d'affaires annuel estimé à plus d'un milliard de dollars. PepsiCo a pour ambition de devenir le leader mondial des produits alimentaires et des boissons par le développement de son projet « Winning with Purpose ». Cette vision reflète la conviction que notre Groupe est intimement lié à la création d’un modèle alimentaire plus durable. L’intégration de la notion de responsabilité sociétale dans toutes nos actions est devenue une priorité. Ce qui nous différencie chez PepsiCo : Un groupe international du monde agroalimentaire Des opportunités de mobilités internes et de CDI pour booster votre carrière Un environnement de travail agréable et flexible centré sur l’humain Une culture de collaboration et d’innovation Venez également rejoindre un environnement où il fait bon travailler : Politique de télétravail Flex office Salle de sport Remboursement partiel de la carte Navigo Mutuelle Restaurant inter-entreprise Pourquoi PepsiCo France ? Avec des marques comme Lay's, Bénénuts, Doritos, Pepsi, Lipton Ice Tea, 7up, ou encore Quaker, PepsiCo France est un acteur incontournable du monde agroalimentaire. Nos collaborateurs s’investissent chaque jour pour façonner les tendances mondiales. Chez PepsiCo, nous avons à cœur de créer un environnement de travail inclusif où chaque personne se sent valorisée et reconnue pour ce qu’elle est. C’est un élément essentiel de notre succès. Chacun de nos collaborateurs apporte à l’entreprise sa valeur ajoutée sans distinction de genre, de diplôme, de religion, d’origine, de nationalité, d’âge et de handicap. PepsiCo accompagne ses collaborateurs dans la mise en place d'éventuels aménagements de poste et de dispositifs d'accessibilité en cas de besoin. Dans le cadre du processus de recrutement, n’hésitez à nous faire part de vos besoins spécifiques (LSF, accessibilité vocale, etc.)

jobs.title: Data & Governance Senior Analyst
jobs.description: Overview Join the Data & Governance Team, part of PepsiCo's A&M Management Capability, at the intersection of Finance, Data, and Marketing. If you enjoy solving data challenges, building new capabilities, and helping shape the future of how global Advertising & Marketing (A&M) investments are managed, measured, and optimized, this is the role for you. The Data & Governance team plays a critical role in enabling A&M Excellence initiatives across PepsiCo by providing the data foundations, reporting capabilities, governance processes, and automation solutions that power better decision-making. We partner closely with global teams, markets, Finance, and Marketing stakeholders to support both annual strategic programs and a wide range of ad-hoc business priorities. Responsibilities Role Scope: Egypt Supply Chain financial planning, forecasting, performance management, cost analysis, productivity tracking, CAPEX support, and business partnering with Supply Chain and cross-functional teams. Role Purpose The FP&A Manager – Supply Chain is responsible for leading the financial planning, forecasting, reporting, and performance management agenda for the Supply Chain function. The role partners closely with Supply Chain leadership, Operations, Procurement, Control, Commercial Finance, and FP&A teams to provide accurate financial analysis, clear business insights, and timely visibility of risks and opportunities. This role translates supply chain financial results into practical actions that support cost discipline, productivity delivery, investment governance, and strong business decision-making. Key Accountabilities Lead the Supply Chain planning and forecasting cycles, including AOP, monthly forecast, rolling forecast, latest estimate, and periodic performance reviews, ensuring timely and accurate submissions aligned with finance timelines and business priorities. Analyze actual results versus plan, forecast, and prior year across supply chain cost lines, identifying key drivers, variances, risks, opportunities, and corrective actions. Partner with Supply Chain teams to track manufacturing, agro, logistics, warehousing, productivity, cost optimization, and operational efficiency performance. Prepare high-quality management reporting packages, dashboards, and leadership updates that clearly explain Supply Chain financial performance and required actions. Support productivity and cost transformation initiatives by validating assumptions, tracking delivery, quantifying financial impact, and highlighting gaps or opportunities. Partner with project owners and cross-functional teams on CAPEX planning, business cases, phasing, spend tracking, and financial governance where relevant. Build and maintain financial models, scenario analysis, and business cases to support decision-making, resource allocation, investment evaluation, and performance improvement initiatives. Ensure strong financial governance, data integrity, documentation, and compliance with PepsiCo finance policies, controls, and reporting requirements. Collaborate with Control, Procurement, Commercial Finance, Operations, and regional or sector Finance teams to validate inputs, align assumptions, and resolve performance or reporting issues. Identify simplification, automation, and continuous improvement opportunities across planning, reporting, and analysis routines to improve speed, accuracy, and decision quality. Support ad-hoc analysis and leadership requests, translating financial data into clear insights and practical recommendations. Coach and guide analysts or junior team members where applicable, supporting capability building, quality review, and delivery of team priorities. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field; CMA, CPA, ACCA, MBA, or equivalent finance qualification is preferred. Minimum of 10 years of relevant finance experience in FP&A, supply chain finance, manufacturing finance, control, reporting, cost management, productivity tracking, or business planning, preferably within FMCG or a multinational environment. Strong understanding of P&L, COGS, manufacturing costs, logistics costs, productivity, forecasting, AOP, variance analysis, financial modeling, and performance management. Experience partnering with Supply Chain, Operations, Procurement, Control, Commercial Finance, and senior stakeholders to support business decisions. Strong knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint; experience with SAP, HFM, Mosaic, Power BI, or related planning and reporting tools is an advantage. Fluency in spoken and written English and Arabic is required. Required Skills and Capabilities Strong financial acumen and analytical thinking, with the ability to connect financial performance to operational drivers. Planning, forecasting, productivity tracking, and performance management capability. Ability to interpret complex data, identify insights, and recommend practical business actions. Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to challenge constructively and influence decisions. Com um portfólio de mais de 500 marcas adoradas, incluindo Gatorade, Lay’s e Quaker, nosso trabalho toca milhões de pessoas todos os dias. No coração da empresa está uma equipe de pensadores, criadores e solucionadores de problemas que colaboram para inovar e transformar ideias em ação. Impulsionados pela inovação e pelo foco em criar momentos de alegria por meio de alimentos e bebidas, nossas decisões são guiadas pela centralidade no consumidor, criando oportunidades para que nossos associados realizem um trabalho significativo e gerem um impacto duradouro nas comunidades que atendemos. Seja qual for o seu papel, você fará parte de uma comunidade global que valoriza suas ideias e o capacita a causar impacto, tanto em sua carreira quanto no mundo ao seu redor. Responsibilities A oportunidade  Senior Manager, Finance Analytics & Data Strategy to lead the intersection between Corporate FP&A leadership and high-scale Data Engineering. In this strategic leadership role, you will act as the primary Finance Business Partner across all corporate finance functions—driving the vision, architecture, and deployment of enterprise-grade financial data solutions, automated reporting products, and Databricks Lakehouse data models.Combining deep financial acumen (p&l profitability, allocations, closing cycles) with hands-on data engineering expertise (Databricks, PySpark, SQL, Unity Catalog). You will translate strategic FP&A requirements into scalable technical roadmaps, enabling self-service analytics for corporate leadership. O seu impacto  Professional with hard skills in finance and a focus on technology/digital transformation/integrating the finance ecosystem/IT for finance/Knowledge and implementation of Finance 4.0. A professional who integrates all financial processes in the area, utilizing various technologies for process optimization, improved decision-making, and reducing workload for the team to be closer to the business. A professional adept at stakeholder management (internal and external) to map global-level processes before determining automation, identifying new tools, and integration. Knowledgeable in statistical modeling, data segmentation for billing, blockchain planning processes, real-time expense tracking – determining appropriate tools for use. Data science expertise, understanding tools, and how to apply them in the process and integrate – business knowledge, application of finance expertise with experience in financial modeling. Proven expertise in Analytics (Power BI, Big Data, AI, Blockchain). Experience in creating a Data Lake for Finance: mapping and data ingestion in collaboration with teams. Program management for training and empowering finance users in Power Platforms tools: Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, and Power Query. Project management and creation of automated/connected financial dashboards in Power BI linked to the data lake, aiming for cost savings generation. Implementation of robots in various finance processes. Construction of the data platform, centralizing information consumption in a single platform with the goal of integrating the finance ecosystem. Qualifications Quem estamos buscando? Experience: Leading Data Engineering, Analytics Business Partnership, or FP&A Technology Transformation within enterprise environments. Financial Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of FP&A workflows, SAP S/4HANA (CO/FI/SD/MM), multi-dimensional profitability allocations, month-end closing cycles, and executive financial reporting. Data Engineering & Architecture: Expert-level proficiency in Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, DLT), Advanced SQL, Python, PySpark, Star Schema Data Modeling, and Medallion Architecture. Orchestration & DevOpsHands-on experience with Azure Data Factory, Airflow DAGs, Databricks Workflows, and Git CI/CD pipelines (GitHub / Azure DevOps). BI & GenAI TechnologiesPower BI, Tableau, Databricks AI/BI, Databricks Genie Agents (Text-to-SQL), and automated financial reconciliations. Se esta é uma oportunidade que te interessa, te encorajamos a se candidatar mesmo que não atenda a 100% dos requisitos.    O que você pode esperar da gente?    Na PepsiCo, queremos recompensar da melhor forma o seu desempenho e trabalho, cuidando sempre do seu bem-estar integral. Por isso, oferecemos:    Remuneração competitiva, com componentes fixos e variáveis que permitirão alcançar suas metas financeiras.  Um programa de flexibilidade que permitirá equilibrar melhor sua vida pessoal e profissional, adaptando seu horário de trabalho ao seu estilo de vida.  Benefícios como seguros, telemedicina e check-up médico, para que você se mantenha sempre em seu melhor estado de saúde.  Com nosso benefício de Auto Executivo, você poderá escolher entre um carro, que inclui também ajuda com combustível e manutenção; ou um bônus de auxílio transporte (apenas para níveis gerenciais L10+).  Um programa de bem, com diferentes iniciativas ao longo do ano, que ajudará a promover mais equilíbri o para a sua saúde física, mental e integral -.  Programas que ajudarão a cuidar do seu bem-estar financeiro e a alcançar suas metas em todas as etapas da sua vida: Programa de Bem-Estar Financeiro, Caixa de Poupança, Fundo de Poupança e Previdência Privada.  Adoramos celebrar o sucesso, por isso contamos com programas de reconhecimento por tempo de trabalho, comportamentos, liderança, momentos de vida, entre outros.  E  como sua família também é importante para nós, estendemos benefícios como nossa Linha de Bem-Estar, Convênios e Descontos, programas de Bolsas de Estudo para seus/suas filhos(as), Planos de Auxílios para diferentes momentos de vida, entre outros.    Na PepsiCo, estamos comprometidos em promover uma equipe de trabalho diversa, criando um espaço colaborativo, equitativo e inclusivo, onde todas as pessoas - independentemente de como nos parecemos, de onde viemos ou a quem amamos - tenham suas vozes ouvidas. Oferecemos igualdade de oportunidades e consideramos os(as) candidatos(as) para todos os cargos, sem distinção de gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou deficiência.

jobs.title: Brand Manager - Smith's
jobs.description: Overview Work for a global FMCG company with some of the world’s most trusted and iconic brands. Be part of an exciting business where employees are recognised and career growth is supported.  At PepsiCo, you can Dare for Better. You can help build a world where there are more possibilities for more people, no matter what role you hold. Together, we’ll make a positive impact for good. Because when we Dare for Better, we can smile at what’s next. For our careers, families, communities and the planet. For you: Competitive benefits package: Annual bonus Car allowance p.a. Discounts on Scoopon, Luxury Escapes, Asahi Beverages portfolio Generous leave options (wellness, birthday, volunteer, 20 weeks parental for both primary & secondary carer, additional leave purchase/cash out) Lease Plan Health & Wellness programs: Discounted private health insurance Financial coaching Counselling sessions Flu vaccinations Skin checks Professional development programs Global career opportunities Job Overview: The Smith’s Brand Manager is accountable for driving growth across priority areas of the Smith’s portfolio, translating consumer, category and commercial insight into clear strategies and high quality execution. The role acts as an owner of defined portfolio growth platforms, partnering with the Smith’s Masterbrand lead and PepsiCo specialist functions to deliver integrated plans across brand, innovation, media, shopper and customer activation. Due to an internal promotion/transition within the team, we are now hiring for this role. Responsibilities Drive portfolio and brand growth. Own the strategy and performance of assigned Smith’s portfolio areas, identifying the biggest opportunities to grow penetration, relevance, value share and profitability while strengthening the Smith’s Masterbrand. Lead Integrated Commercial Planning (ICP) and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) development. Translate human, category, customer and commercial insights into clear where-to-play and how-to-win choices for your portfolio, developing a focused three-year roadmap, annual brand plans and measurable Must Win Battles. Shape portfolio architecture and Revenue Growth Management (RGM) choices. Partner with Category, Sales, Shopper, Insights and Finance to define the role of sub-ranges, formats, packs and price points, improving range effectiveness, availability, value delivery and customer relevance. Partner with cross-functional teams to deliver consumer-led innovation and renovation. Indentify opportunities and deliver a commercially viable pipeline, partnering with Global teams, Insights, R&D, Commercialisation, Supply Chain and Finance from opportunity definition and learning plans through to launch readiness and post-launch evaluation. Deliver integrated Total Connections Planning (TCP). Partnering with Masterbrand owner and with Media, Digital, Shopper and Creative teams; develop connected plans across all media consumption behaviours. Ensure communications are insight-led, channel-right and designed to recruit and retain buyers. Own performance and investment discipline. Lead monthly performance diagnostics across scan, panel, ex-factory, brand health and media data. Manage investment, forecasts and agency scopes, prioritising activity that maximises ROI and delivers AOP outcomes. Mobilise the cross-functional team. Act as the day-to-day business lead for assigned priorities, creating clarity on decisions, owners, risks and next actions across Marketing, Sales, Category, Shopper, Insights, R&D, Commercialisation, Supply Chain and Finance. Qualifications 5+ years’ FMCG marketing experience, with demonstrated ownership of brands, portfolios or significant growth projects. Ability to translate human, category and commercial insight into focused brand and portfolio choices, multi-year growth plans and executable AOPs. Strong understanding of CPG economics, customer and channel dynamics, P&L drivers, RGM principles and how marketing investment creates value. Strong analytical capability across scan, household panel, ex-factory, brand health and media data, with the ability to isolate growth drivers and recommend action. Experience briefing and leading creative, media, digital and shopper programs, with a clear view of the role each channel plays across the consumer and shopper journey. Proven ability to align and mobilise matrixed teams across Sales, Category, Shopper, Insights, R&D, Commercialisation, Supply Chain and Finance. Able to create clarity in complexity, make sound recommendations with incomplete information, manage multiple critical priorities and escalate risks early.

jobs.title: Senior Brand Manager
jobs.description: Overview WHAT MAKES YOU UNIQUE, MAKES US BETTER Are you looking for a new challenge and ready to make an impact within one of the world's leading FMCG companies? Bring your talent, energy and unique perspective to PepsiCo. We empower our people to make a global impact, drive meaningful change and shape the future of some of the world's most loved brands. You will have the opportunity to accelerate your career in a collaborative, dynamic and international environment. The Opportunity The PepsiCo France Marketing Team is looking for an experienced Senior Brand Manager to join the business and play a key role in driving sustainable brand growth across our portfolio. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine strategic thinking, commercial acumen and marketing excellence while leading cross-functional projects and influencing business decisions across multiple stakeholders. Responsibilities As a Senior Brand Manager, you will: Act as the business leader for your brand portfolio, owning key performance indicators including volumes, market share, P&L and marketing budgets. Develop and recommend annual brand strategies and marketing plans aligned with business objectives and growth ambitions. Independently lead the execution of marketing initiatives, ensuring effective implementation and strong business impact. Define and oversee integrated communication and media strategies to increase brand awareness, engagement and penetration. Drive portfolio initiatives, including innovation, renovation and long-term brand development projects. Translate consumer, shopper and market insights into actionable recommendations and growth opportunities. Collaborate closely with regional and international teams to ensure strategic alignment and successful execution of key initiatives. Partner with cross-functional stakeholders including Sales, Category Management, Insights, Finance, Supply Chain, R&D and external agencies. Influence key business decisions through strong analytical thinking and data-driven recommendations. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Marketing or a related field. Minimum 8 years of experience in FMCG Marketing. Proven experience in Brand Management and delivering business growth. Demonstrated ability to lead brand growth through successful marketing initiatives and business-driving projects. Strong commercial acumen with experience managing budgets, business performance and strategic plans. Experience working successfully within complex matrix and international organizations. Ability to translate insights into strategic recommendations and business actions. Strong project management and execution capabilities. Excellent stakeholder management and influencing skills. Fluency in English & French, both written and spoken. Commercial or Sales experience would be considered an advantage. Why PepsiCo France? With iconic brands such as Lay's®, Doritos®, Benenuts®, Pepsi®, Lipton Ice Tea®, 7UP® and Quaker®, PepsiCo France is a key player in the FMCG industry. At PepsiCo, you'll have the opportunity to work on brands loved by millions of consumers while collaborating with talented teams across local, regional and global markets. We believe in empowering our people, encouraging innovation and creating opportunities for growth and development. Our culture is built on collaboration, ownership and a shared passion for winning together. What Makes PepsiCo Different A leading global food and beverage company. Exposure to internationally recognized brands. Opportunities for career growth and internal mobility. Dynamic, entrepreneurial and collaborative culture. Flexible and hybrid ways of working. International environment with strong regional and global connections. A business committed to sustainability and positive impact. Our Benefits Hybrid working policy. Flexible office environment. Competitive compensation package. Annual performance bonus. Health insurance. Transportation allowance. Company restaurant. Access to on-site gym facilities. Learning and development opportunities. Diversity & Inclusion At PepsiCo, we are committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, disability or background. Diversity is one of our greatest strengths and an essential driver of our success. PepsiCo supports employees by providing reasonable accommodations and accessibility solutions whenever needed. During the recruitment process, please let us know if you require any specific accommodations or support.

jobs.title: Supply Chain Industrial Placement - Process Lead Support Bursom 2027
jobs.description: Overview You’ve learned a lot as a student already. Want to put it into practice at PepsiCo? Our placement programmes are structured to give you the chance to make an impact on some of the world’s biggest brands. From day one, you’ll be working on projects that matter. You’ll shake things up, shape trends, and get guidance and development to help you discover your potential. We are looking for enthusiastic undergraduates to join our Supply Chain team on a 12-month placement programme starting in July 2027 on a full time basis. Everyday millions of people in the UK enjoy our oats, snacks, juices and beverages. As a placement student within Supply Chain, you will have the opportunity to join our 4,500 strong team who are behind these household names. As a function we are spread across 10 sites which include our Quaker Oats Mill in Cupar and our Walkers Crisp factory in Leicester – the largest crisp factory in the world. Undergraduate placement students have an important part to play in our future and we provide a perfect environment for individuals to develop, whilst feeling valued and having lots of fun. You will have lots of autonomy where your decisions will really make a difference to our business and in return you will have the chance to develop your skills and experience in a fast paced, energetic environment. Responsibilities In this placement you will: Analyse performance data and metric trends, preparing validated data and loss trees to support Daily and Weekly Direction Setting Facilitate problem-solving sessions and apply structured methodologies, including 6W2H and UPS, to identify root causes and implement sustainable corrective actions Support the Process Lead in delivering loss elimination activities, including GEMBA walks and equipment and process improvement workstreams, while establishing new operating standards and monitoring their impact on performance Support continuous improvement projects across equipment and manufacturing processes Work with line teams to deliver zone physical standard improvements and maintain effective workplace standards Contribute to SPARK activities by developing centreline parameters, supporting rapid changeovers and completing system health checks Train, coach and support operators and Front Line Employees in the effective execution of Daily Management Systems Build practical knowledge of manufacturing processes and Manufacturing Excellence programmes, including SPARK, Integrated Work Systems and Lean Six Sigma Be given real-life objectives to work on and will be expected to make a noticeable contribution to your department Qualifications What are we looking for? Students that have the full RTW for the duration of the full time placement (July 2027-July 2028). Students currently in their penultimate year of university studies, where the course includes the option of completing a sandwich placement before returning to study after the placement. Following path to a degree in in Mechanical/Electrical, Chemical or Manufacturing Engineering or closely related disciplines An intellectual curiosity and a willingness to challenge accepted ways of doing things Passion, for our company, for your development, for sustainability and engineering delivery Ambition, eagerness to learn and grow your career and aspire to be our future leaders Creativity, bring your new thinking and fresh ideas to our brands You! At PepsiCo we bring ourselves to work and embrace diversity and inclusion. We believe our differences is what makes us special. What else do you need to know? Our placements start in July 2027 on a full-time basis and will last for 12 months, with a salary of £26,600. Other benefits: Vibrant culture Development and mentoring 25 days annual leave plus 8 days bank holidays Discounted PepsiCo products Competitive pension scheme Market-leading health and wellbeing benefits: Virtual GP: available to you and your family 24/7, Discounted gym membership, SWORD; online free digital physiotherapy service Our application process involves: Online application Video Interview sent to you by HR: September- October 2026 Virtual Assesment Center: November – December 2026 Application Closing Date: 20th October 2026 Our application window is scheduled to close on the above date, however, in the event of a large response we will close applications early. We would therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible. About PepsiCo PepsiCo products are enjoyed by consumers more than one billion times a day in more than 200 countries and territories around the world. PepsiCo generated nearly $92 billion in net revenue in 2024, driven by a complementary beverage and convenient foods portfolio that includes Lay’s, Doritos, Cheetos, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Mountain Dew, Quaker, and SodaStream. PepsiCo’s product portfolio includes a wide range of enjoyable foods and beverages, including many iconic brands that generate more than $1 billion each in estimated annual retail sales. Guiding PepsiCo is our vision to Be the Global Leader in Beverages and Convenient Foods by Winning with pep+ (PepsiCo Positive). pep+ is our strategic end-to-end transformation that puts sustainability and human capital at the centre of how we will create value and growth by operating within planetary boundaries and inspiring positive change for planet and people.

jobs.title: FP&A Assoc Analyst
jobs.description: Overview CAREERS TO SMILE ABOUT At PepsiCo, you’ll discover a place where our mission is to create smiles around the world. With a portfolio of more than 500 beloved brands including, Gatorade, Lay’s and Quaker, our work touches millions of people every day. At the heart of the company is a team of thinkers, creators, and problem-solvers who collaborate to innovate and turn ideas into action. Driven by innovation and a focus on creating joyful moments through food and drinks, our decisions are guided by consumer centricity, creating opportunities for our associates to do meaningful work and make a lasting impact in the communities we serve. Whatever your role, you’ll be part of a global community that values your ideas and empowers you to make an impact, on your career and on the world around you. Responsibilities FP&A Associate Analyst The Opportunity in Mexico City! Join PepsiCo’s Finance team and contribute to financial planning and performance analysis across Latin America. In this role, you will help consolidate financial information, monitor business performance, and prepare reports that support planning and decision-making across commercial and finance teams. You will collaborate with stakeholders across different markets, gaining exposure to regional business priorities while developing your analytical skills and understanding of the financial drivers behind business results. Your Impact As an FP&A Associate Analyst, you will: Financial Reporting: Consolidate and validate regional financial information related to sales, revenue, innovation, and other key business indicators. Performance Analysis: Monitor financial results, identify key trends and variances, and help explain business performance through clear, data-driven insights. Planning Support: Assist with forecast and Annual Operating Plan (AOP) reporting, ensuring information is accurate and delivered on time. Dashboard & Report Preparation: Prepare and maintain reports, trackers, and dashboards that provide visibility into financial performance and key performance indicators (KPIs).
